svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-08-05
svg.desc: Modular beam nodes and dynamic ability spec source tags.
svg.text: 2026-08-05 - Modular beam nodes and dynamic spec tags
main | 2 commits: 779c09f, ff69b6e
Daily job
Turn Electrocute into reusable graph pieces and preserve runtime-generated ability identity.
ModularBeamNodes, Electrocute XML/original node, ASC/DataAbility/config/tests, and GAS docs changed.
BEFORE
Monolithic beam and stale tag source
Electrocute behavior lived in a larger action path.
Ability source tags could miss runtime-generated specs.
Beam initialization, target, visual, and damage
responsibilities were harder to reuse.
AFTER
Reusable beam composition and dynamic identity
ModularBeamNodes exposes initialization, targeting, visual, and damage operations.
Electrocute XML and the original node use the modular path.
Consumers switch to GetDynamicSpecSourceTags() for runtime-generated specs.
GAS ability documentation explains the new beam model.
Guard: composition should preserve both target behavior and spec identity.
Important guard
Use modular nodes for reuse; do not clone
the old monolith. Read dynamic spec tags
when identity is created at runtime.
Validation / newcomer path
Trace XML -> ModularBeamNodes -> target/visual/damage.
Then trace ASC/DataAbility source tags and graph tests.
This is the bridge into the Aug 06-11 hardening arc.
